column1: Recent indicators suggest that economic activity has been expanding at a moderate pace.
Job gains have been robust in recent months, and the unemployment rate has remained low.
The U.S. banking system is sound and resilient .  Tighter credit conditions for households
and businesses are likely to weigh on economic activity, hiring, and inflation.  The extent of these effects remains uncertain.
